description: Search the NYC Council's expense funding disclosure — the Council's own award-level list of discretionary expense designations, FY2009 and FY2011–FY2027 (FY2010 is NOT included: the Council's archived workbook for it is incomplete against NYC Open Data, so it is left out). One row per published row (exact copies are kept and flagged), with clearance status, funding stream, agency and the grantee's mailing address; MOCS ID from FY2024, and for FY2009–FY2021 the MOCS ID NYC Open Data gives the same designation (od_mocs_id) where the pairing is unambiguous. FY2009 and FY2013 are EARLY SNAPSHOTS: frozen while much was Pending and never revised, so their Cleared totals are not headline figures; the answer says so. This is a later snapshot than the adopted budget: it includes designations made after adoption, and council_member is the roster when the workbook was exported. Every row is returned whatever its status unless you filter on status; the response gives the TRUE number of matching rows and totals over all of them (Cleared and Pending separately), even when the rows shown are limited, plus the file, sheet, source and retrieval date of each year. Filter by any combination of fiscal_year, ein, legal_name, council_member (substring) or council_member_id (exact Legistar person ID — 'Levin' and 'Levine' are different people), source (substring) or source_exact, agency, program_name, zip (exact 5-digit), zip_status, city (exact), status, mocs_id, od_mocs_id, min_amount, max_amount. Rows come highest amount first. Purpose text is not served; each row gives its workbook row number in the source repo. Text filters ignore case and accents; a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words only ('AI' finds 'AI-powered', not 'AIDS'), a longer one matches anywhere; whole_word true or false overrides that.

city.description: Grantee mailing city, exact match ignoring case and surrounding whitespace, as printed: 'brooklyn' matches 'Brooklyn' and 'BROOKLYN', but not the cells printed 'Brooklyn,' or 'Brooklyn NY', and 'Bronx' does not match 'The Bronx'; 'New York' is how most Manhattan rows print. Not a borough or district filter.

council_member.description: Council member as the workbook names them (case-insensitive substring; 'Levin' also matches 'Levine', and the answer lists every value matched with its Legistar person ID) — the roster at export time, e.g. 'Speaker' for Speaker's designations. For one person, use council_member_id.

council_member_id.description: Exact Legistar person ID of the council member (e.g. '7567' Stephen T. Levin, '7634' Mark Levine), as resolved per fiscal year by the repo's member crosswalk from the Council MCP's Legistar index. Rows whose printed name is ambiguous, unresolved, a delegation, 'Speaker' or blank carry no ID and never match. Digits only.

ein.description: Grantee tax ID: exactly 9 digits, hyphens optional (anything else is an error, never padded). Matches the grantee EIN only, not the fiscal conduit's. One EIN can cover many bodies (136400434 is the City of New York); the answer says how many legal names it matched.

fiscal_year.description: FY2009 or FY2011–FY2027. FY2010 is not in the dataset; asking for it returns the reason.

legal_name.description: Grantee legal name (substring, case-insensitive; % and _ are literal)

limit.description: Max rows shown, 1–500 (default 50; above 500 is capped at 500, below 1 is an error). Totals always cover every match.

mocs_id.description: The workbook's own MOCS ID, exact (case and surrounding whitespace ignored), e.g. 'FY26 01234'. Printed from FY2024 only.

od_mocs_id.description: NYC Open Data 4d7f-74pe's MOCS ID for the same designation, exact (case and surrounding whitespace ignored), e.g. 'FY09 2838'. FY2009–FY2021 only, and only where the pairing is unambiguous. A cross-reference, not a source.

source.description: Funding stream as the workbook names it (case-insensitive substring; 'Youth' also matches initiatives such as 'Summer Youth Employment Program', and the answer lists every value matched): Local, Youth, Aging, Speaker's Initiative, or a citywide initiative name. For one stream exactly, use source_exact.

source_exact.description: Funding stream, exact: equal to the workbook's value ignoring case and surrounding whitespace ('Youth' matches the Youth stream only).

status.description: Restrict to one clearance status. Omit for all (the default; totals are still reported per status).

whole_word.description: Sets how name and prose filters match: true, whole words only ('AI' not in 'Jamaica', 'Fellow' not in 'Fellowship'); false, anywhere ('AI' in 'AIDS'). Omit for the default: a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words, a longer one anywhere.

zip.description: Grantee mailing ZIP, exactly 5 digits (anything else is an error). Matches the 5-digit zip derived from the published postal_code (ZIP+4 read to its first five; a 4-digit ZIP padded, a ragged ZIP+4 trimmed, or a 6-digit ZIP repaired, only into a 2020 ZCTA of the row's own state; or settled by the street address where it matches exactly one address in the City's PAD file, zip_status repaired_by_address). Rows whose zip_status is ambiguous_extra_digit, invalid or blank have no zip and never match. A mailing address, not where services were delivered.

zip_status.description: BetaNYC's ZIP check, not a Council field: the printed ZIP against the Census 2020 ZCTAs, not the street. valid (a ZCTA in the row's state; a ZIP wrong for the street passes), padded (leading zero restored), trimmed (ragged ZIP+4 such as '11203-'), repaired_extra_digit (6 digits printed; exactly one one-digit deletion is an in-state ZCTA, e.g. '111691' -> 11691), ambiguous_extra_digit (6 digits; two or more deletions are, e.g. '114345' -> 11434 or 11435; no zip, candidates shown on the row), not_a_zcta (not verified, not fake: PO-box ZIPs have no ZCTA), state_mismatch, invalid (no ZIP readable), blank (none printed); and, from a street-address check against the City's PAD address file (#247), repaired_by_address (an ambiguous_extra_digit row whose address matches exactly one NYC address, whose ZIP is one of the candidates) and nyc_address_confirmed (a state_mismatch row whose address and ZIP match exactly one NYC address: the printed state is wrong).
